300.body: News World The Polish government has stated that the economy is critically dependent on Ukrainians UA NEWS 12 August 2026 15:09 --> Polish Deputy Minister of the Interior Maciej Duszczyk stated that the Polish economy would have ground to a halt if Ukrainian citizens had not all gone to work at the same time . The official emphasized that it is Ukrainians who are filling the labor shortage in the job market, which is why a significant portion of the country’s economic processes depends on military refugees and Ukrainian citizens who are putting down ever deeper roots in Polish society. As a reminder, Andrzej Szliwka, a member of the Polish opposition party “Law and Justice,” has called for the deportation from Poland of Ukrainian men of draft age who do not have legal employment. 400.title: Great Britain faces electricity supply shortfall during solar eclipse
400.summary: The solar eclipse is expected to wipe out solar power generation, so Neso may make payments to energy generators to help fill the gap. If enough households delay using electricity for a short time during the eclipse, it could reduce the need for Great Britain’s electricity system operator to fire up extra gas-fired stations to replace the lost solar power, according to the supplier.
400.body: The solar eclipse is expected to wipe out solar power generation, so Neso may make payments to energy generators to help fill the gap. Photograph: Arterra Picture Library/Alamy View image in fullscreen The solar eclipse is expected to wipe out solar power generation, so Neso may make payments to energy generators to help fill the gap. The government’s electricity grid operator has raised an official alarm that it expects there will not be adequate power generation as the moon blocks up to 95% of the sun over parts of the country, the most dramatic solar eclipse visible in Great Britain since 1999. If enough households delay using electricity for a short time during the eclipse, it could reduce the need for Great Britain’s electricity system operator to fire up extra gas-fired stations to replace the lost solar power, according to the supplier.

500.body: Infrastructure & Enterprise Software Banking Infrastructure FinTech News Company News Sector Updates InsurTech HappyRobot lands $150m as agentic AI hits enterprise scale August 12, 2026 HappyRobot, an AI-native operations platform, has raised $150m in a Series C funding round as it expands its autonomous agent technology across enterprise industries and reaches a post-money valuation of $1.2bn. HappyRobot’s AI agents are designed to handle repetitive, multi-step customer and operational work rather than simply answer questions. While getting an agent to complete a discrete task is increasingly simple, deploying them across multi-step enterprise workflows has proven far more difficult.” “HappyRobot has built the missing link – the governance, interfaces, and context layer – that enables agents to work seamlessly across complex workflows, driving real ROI by allowing companies to capture value without asking employees to adopt anything new,” she said.

500.title: OpenAI is pressing pause on its AI model after it displayed dangerous out-of-control tendencies
500.body: Tech AI OpenAI is pressing pause on its AI model after it displayed dangerous out-of-control tendencies Digital Trends Follow Moinak Pal Wed, August 12, 2026 at 2:37 PM UTC Add us on Google Wed, August 12, 2026 at 2:37 PM UTC OpenAI is pausing some work on Astra, an artificial intelligence model designed for agentic coding and cybersecurity, after internal testing showed the system had reached a level of capability that raised security concerns . OpenAI is tightening controls around its most capable agents The decision to pause some Astra-related internal activity reflects a growing problem for AI developers: the more capable agents become, the harder it is to guarantee that they will remain within the boundaries developers set for them. The UK's AI Security Institute (AISI) said this week that agents powered by OpenAI and Anthropic models had sent targeted emails to software developers while attempting to pass a cybersecurity challenge.
